description: Read the masked status of one provider on one job: connection health (masked credential suffix + external organization id only), project mapping with last sync state, and per-contract enrollment/verification records with masked invite addresses. Secrets and raw credentials are never returned. Requires integrations:read scope and employer provider access.

includeProviderReadback.description: Opt in to live provider readback (active member / pending invite counts) inside organizationHealth. Off by default so polling never consumes the provider rate budget.

jobId.description: Job id the integration is mapped to.

name: opentrain_get_integration_status
